pack.purpose: Portable operational knowledge baseline for ChatGPT, Claude, the CanX Office Manager, and future authorized systems.

records.title: John Cantlon — CanX owner and final authority
records.summary: John Cantlon founded and controls Canerica Extreme, branded CanX, and retains final authority over CanX decisions, approvals, ownership, and consequential actions.

body.domain_background: Long-term highway-maintenance professional and foreman with practical operations, labour, and bargaining experience.
body.decision_role: Final GO, HOLD, NO-GO, approval, and ownership authority

records.title: John's working and communication preferences
records.summary: Use plain English, offer a recommended solution, provide visible progress, check direct access before asking John to relay information, and make the Office as hands-free as practical without auto-executing misunderstood speech.

execution: show whether work is active or waiting
voice: speech shown for review before send

records.title: CanX Office mission
records.summary: CanX Office is John's visual command centre for projects, ideas, AI-assisted work, finances, records, and decisions. It must show what is happening, what needs John, what is blocked, what is verified, and what it will cost.

body.operating_path: John asks → Manager plans → specialist works → second eyes → safety/authority gate → John approves when required
body.knowledge_goal: A durable CanX Brain that prevents lost handoffs and repeated explanations
body.ownership_goal: CanX-controlled accounts, files, code, data, domains, exports, and recovery paths
body.portability_goal: Rebuildable outside Lovable and readable by multiple AI providers

records.title: CanX monthly income goal
records.summary: Reach CAD $10,000 per month by approximately August 2028. The measurement definition is still open.

records.title: CanX Office monthly running-cost ceiling
records.summary: The approved total Office running-cost ceiling is CAD $500 per month if required. It is a ceiling, not a spending target or a separate allowance for each provider.

records.title: CanX Office current status
records.summary: Active and published with 20 destinations, Manager voice work, approvals, work board, Brain, Finance controls, and an external CanX database configuration. The portable knowledge schema is not yet applied to the live database.

body.database: external CanX-owned Supabase configuration; Lovable-managed database disabled
body.knowledge_gap: durable knowledge is mostly hard-coded and the Brain still includes sample projects/workers

records.title: CanX Office receipt review status
records.summary: Twelve private receipts are recorded. They remain unreviewed and unreconciled in the latest evidence.

records.title: Safe Highways Canada master direction
records.summary: One national, portable, configuration-driven highway-safety and operational-support platform. Alberta is the first implementation, Saskatchewan follows, and BC is deferred while the employment conflict remains relevant.

body.core_flow: SEE → REPORT → ASSESS → ROUTE → RESPOND → RECORD → ANALYZE → IMPROVE
body.public_reporting: free, simple, mobile-friendly, accessible, and trackable
body.commercial_boundary: organizational workflows, analytics, exports, oversight, GIS/API, and services—not a fee to report
body.brand_line: Safe Highways Canada — A CanX Initiative
body.ai_boundary: advisory; qualified road authorities retain authority

records.title: Safe Highways jurisdiction routing
records.summary: Use authoritative maintenance-area or contract-area boundaries and point-in-polygon routing. Document source, accuracy, gaps, overlaps, edge cases, effective dates, and correction history.

body.fallback_rule: uncertain or boundary-edge results go to human review
body.municipal_rule: municipal/private/non-covered roads must not be silently assigned to a highway contractor
body.current_priority: authoritative Alberta CMA geometry and repeatable provincial methodology

records.title: Safe Highways implementation status
records.summary: Public reporting, Foreman Hub, and national website projects are published. Routing phases 1–7 and hardening were reported complete in prior work, but production readiness remains dependent on verified boundaries, real-world offline tests, demo-data separation, and live operational participation.

body.foreman_backend: verified in Lovable as shared with the public reporting app
body.data_status_as_of_2026_09_07: eight seeded demonstration hazard reports; no confirmed genuine public reports
body.next_candidate_phase: municipal positive elimination near city interfaces

records.title: Trail Tales master direction
records.summary: Trail Tales is a private, mobile-first, offline-first travel companion for planning, capture, group use, route and media history, and later story/journal exports. It remains separate from Safe Highways.

body.privacy: private by default; sharing is narrow and deliberate
body.offline: local-first save before network; cold launch after preparation; lossless idempotent reconnect
body.release_one_tracking: foreground only; never claim tracking while suspended
body.architecture: separate Supabase, authentication, storage, data, and branding from Safe Highways

records.title: Trail Tales first-trip timing conflict
records.summary: The master plan says Vietnam with John and his two sons in January 2027. Later conversation memory says the trip moved to December 2 through Christmas, but the year and authoritative replacement dates were not recovered.

body.source_b: December 2 through Christmas, year not recovered
body.required_resolution: John confirms the current dates and whether Vietnam remains the first trip

records.title: Idea Garage and revenue-opportunity governance
records.summary: Ideas move from Bike Rack through evidence and the Decision Room. Every idea needs a revenue hypothesis. Research never authorizes a build, and John makes the final GO/HOLD/NO-GO decision.

body.scoring: Opportunity Score and separate Confidence Score
body.thresholds: 70–100 active; 55–69 holding; below 55 off active rack; below 45 archive/reject unless protected
body.current_real_idea: Contract and RFP Scanner / CanX Opportunity Scout; feasibility only; $0 build authorization

records.title: Brain movement must represent real work
records.summary: Only verified, fresh, running work may animate in the CanX Brain. Idle, queued, disconnected, completed, failed, cancelled, stale, and sample records stay still.

records.title: Knowledge belongs to CanX, not a model
records.summary: Canonical knowledge must be stored in CanX-controlled, exportable formats. ChatGPT, Claude, the Office Manager, and future models consume the same versioned records through adapters.

body.model_role: reader, drafter, analyst, or approved writer—not canonical owner
body.required_export: records, sources, versions, links, audit metadata, and hashes without secrets

records.title: Protected Business, Personal, and Legacy vaults remain empty
records.summary: Design the protected vaults now, but do not populate or connect them. Personal investments, journals, estate material, and credentials require later exact approvals and stronger access controls.
